webhooks.authentication_requirement: The webhook must authenticate as a specific trusted provider before it is admitted.
webhooks.integrity_requirement: The webhook must pass integrity verification confirming it was not altered in transit.
webhooks.replay_protection_dependency: The webhook is protected against replay so a re-delivered signal produces no duplicate governed effect.
webhooks.reconciliation_dependency: The provider's asserted outcome becomes authoritative only after reconciliation against the House governed state.

callbacks.unknown_outcome_posture: An unknown provider outcome is never optimistically treated as success and never silently treated as failure; it is held as unresolved.
callbacks.reconciliation_dependency: The callback outcome becomes authoritative only after reconciliation against the House governed state.
